title: Smoke-Filled Room
text: This ward's bosses only deal with proven operators. Play 2 conspiracies before you can capture it.

title: Pay to Play
text: Nothing moves here without money behind it. Hold 8+ total resources to capture this zone.

title: The Party Line
text: These voters want conviction, not slogans. Reach 3 cards in any one ideology first.

title: Dirty Tricks Welcome
text: They respect a candidate who fights ugly. Spring a volatile trap on your rival first.

title: Ground Game
text: No fly-in candidates. Have voters in 4+ constituencies before this one takes you seriously.

title: Own the Airwaves
text: This district votes for whoever's on TV. Hold 4+ media at once to capture it.

title: The Machinery
text: The local machine wants a partner with reach. Hold a majority somewhere else first.

title: The Toll
text: Capturing this zone costs 2 extra resources, paid on the spot. Everyone pays the toll.

title: The High Bar
text: A skeptical crowd: you need one voter beyond the usual majority to take this zone.

title: Hearts and Minds
text: They can smell a cynic. Hold at least 2 public trust when you capture this zone.

title: Solvency Check
text: This district has been burned by debtors before. No outstanding IOU when you capture it.

title: The Fortress
text: Old walls, old habits. This constituency can never be gerrymandered, by anyone.

title: Restless Streets
text: Turnout here is chaos. The majority threshold rises by 1 for everyone.

title: The Ghost Ward
text: Half the register is dead or gone. The majority threshold drops by 1 for everyone.
